dct_title_s: Il disegno della geografia moderna de tutta la parte dell'Africa
dct_description_sm: Rare separate map printed on eight copperplates. The sea is stippled with many ships and sea monsters.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0008, p. 11
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0008.
